trace.name: brain.who_knows
trace.cypher: CALL db.idx.vector.queryNodes('Task','embedding',15,vecf32($emb)) YIELD node AS t, score WITH t, 1 - score AS sim WHERE sim >= 0.55 MATCH (t)<-[:SOLVES]-(s:Solution)<-[:PRODUCED]-(:Session)<-[:RAN]-(d:Dev)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(tm:Team) RETURN d.name AS dev, tm.name AS team, s.id AS sol, s.title AS title, sim, s.effort_minutes AS effort, s.status AS status
